svg.title: Flow figure: Browser, Gateway, Cart, Orders, Payments, Mail. Steps: Place an order, Add to cart.
svg.desc: The figure has these boxes: Browser, Gateway, Cart, Orders, Payments, Mail. Place an order. The gateway asks Orders to place the order. Orders asks Payments to charge the card. Payments asks Mail to send the receipt. Add to cart. The browser sends the item. The gateway adds the item to the cart. Gateway: Route the call, Sign in, Rate limit. Ports: in: from Browser, out: to Orders, out: to Cart. Gateway > Sign in: Read the token, Check the signature, Load the user, Check the role, Make the context. Ports: in: from Route the call, out: to Rate limit. Cart: Find the cart, Add the item, Price the cart, Save the cart. Ports: in: from Gateway. Cart > Price the cart: Load the price rules, Apply the discount, Add the tax, Round the total, Sum the cart. Ports: in: from Add the item, out: to Save the cart. Orders: Check the cart, Reserve the stock, Sum the order, Save the order, Publish the event. Ports: in: from Gateway, out: to Payments. Orders > Check the cart: Parse the cart, Check the items, Check the stock, Check the address, Check the limits. Ports: in: from Gateway, out: to Reserve the stock. Payments: Make the intent, Charge the card, Record the payment, Send the event. Ports: in: from Orders, out: to Mail. Payments > Charge the card: Make a card token, Call the provider, Check 3-D Secure, Capture the money, Read the result. Ports: in: from Make the intent, out: to Record the payment. Mail: Pick the template, Fill the template, Queue the mail, Send the mail. Ports: in: from Payments.

g.text: The gateway asks Orders to place the order.
Orders asks Payments to charge the card.
Payments asks Mail to send the receipt.
The gateway adds the item to the cart.
